title_zh: 限定帝国地图展品说明中的历史结论

scenario.label_zh: 限定帝国地图展品说明中的历史结论
scenario.goal_zh: 核对地图和旅行记摘录的证据范围，删去无法证明的控制范围与发现结论

context_zh: 博物馆志愿者依据一组虚构档案材料核对展品标签，不讨论现实新闻。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: The label says this map proves the empire controlled every town shown. Is that what the source says?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: No. It shows the routes used during that era, but a route is not the same as a border.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: Then we can describe the routes, but not an expansion of trade unless we have earlier records to compare them with.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: Exactly. This extract from a traveller's journal mentions markets along the route, but it does not tell us whether trade was growing.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: Does it also prove the existence of the northern town marked with a question mark?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: Not on its own. The traveller says someone told him about it; he did not visit.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: Calling it an extraordinary discovery would overstate the evidence.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: Yes. Let us make this exhibit about what the map and journal can, and cannot, tell us.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: I will remove the claim about controlling every town and keep the uncertain place marked clearly.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: I will add the journal reference beside the extract so visitors can see its source.

targets.sense_zh: 展品，展览中的展示项目
